title: Physics speed changes with frame rate — dt is ignored
body: World.step(dt) is supposed to advance the simulation by dt seconds, but it actually advances by a hardcoded 1/60s regardless of dt. At 30fps everything moves at half speed; at 144fps it's more than double. step(0.5) with velocity 120 should move x by 60.0.
bug: World.step ignores its dt argument and integrates with a hardcoded 1/60 timestep.
